title: `Engine::register_singleton` with `RefCounted` arguments can cause UB
body:
### Tested versions

4.6-stable

### System information

Linux

### Issue description

[`Engine::register_singleton`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/eb7cfe13625ce49d57834b3fbbc96df8f0cbf447/core/core_bind.cpp#L1999) accepts any `Object` instances, so also `RefCounted` ones. In the same way, [`Engine::get_singleton_object()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/eb7cfe13625ce49d57834b3fbbc96df8f0cbf447/core/config/engine.cpp#L333-L344) (exposed as `get_singleton`) returns always `Object*`.

Internally though, Godot only stores an `Object*` and no `Ref<...>`:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ea1fb9095e9692a8ffc32465ef53d45043044c56/core/config/engine.h#L45-L54



There are some locations in the code which suggest it _is_ possible to have ref-counted singletons:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/eb7cfe13625ce49d57834b3fbbc96df8f0cbf447/core/config/engine.cpp#L444-L454

But this is a pure debug check, no refcount increment. 
And I don't even see how it's possible to satisfy the error, as the signature is `Object*` and not `Ref<...>`.

I dug a bit, this was changed in 2020: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/e79162ec4e7f7813a38d5df3b508a6dce65bb6d4. Before the message was:
```cpp
ERR_PRINT("A class intended to be used as a singleton must *not* inherit from Reference.");
```

I found an interesting piece of history: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/43783#issuecomment-732049746. Apparently registering `RefCounted` singletons "worked" by pure accident -- another bug, `Variant` not tracking ref-counts, would implicitly treat `RefCounted` (at the time `Reference`) singletons like `Object` ones. 

But this has not been the case since Godot 4, and the comment shows the exact problem I'm mentioning here.

Ref-counted singletons also cause problems in other places:
- #118549
- https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext/issues/522


### Steps to reproduce

GDScript:
```gdscript
extends Node

func _ready():
    Engine.register_singleton("Shortlived", RefCounted.new())
    # Singleton is already dead here.
    var rc = Engine.get_singleton("Shortlived")

    print("object:   ", rc)
    print("refcount: ", rc.get_reference_count())
    get_tree().quit()
```

Output with `godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64 --headless`:
```gdscript
Godot Engine v4.7.dev.custom_build.caf16709a (2026-04-18 12:28:38 UTC) - https://godotengine.org

object:   <Object#null>
refcount: <null>
```

GDScript seems sound (even in Release mode), but with GDExtension it's quite easy to run into UB. The problem is that `RefCounted` comes with the invariant that the last reference destroys the object, and Godot stores an _owning but not ref-counted_ pointer to it.
